scripts.tablet: npm run build -w @faminder/shared && npm run start -w @faminder/tablet
scripts.build: npm run build -w @faminder/shared && npm run build -w @faminder/api && npm run build -w @faminder/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @faminder/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
